photo.description: Photographic evidence taken at or after the incident.

vehicle.description: Photos of involved vehicles, damage, license plates.

scene.description: Photos of the location, road conditions, signage.

injury.description: Photos of bodily injuries. Sensitive — flag for restricted handling.

video.description: Video evidence — dashcam, surveillance, bystander recordings.

official.description: Documents issued by an authority or institution.

police-report.description: Police, sheriff, or highway-patrol incident report.

dmv-record.description: DMV or equivalent registration / title / abstract record.

court-document.description: Filings, subpoenas, judgments related to the claim.

repair-estimate.description: Body shop or contractor estimate for repairs.

invoice.description: Paid or unpaid invoice for services rendered.

medical.description: Health-related documents tied to the claim.

record.description: Treatment notes, diagnosis records, imaging reports.

correspondence.description: Communications between parties tied to the claim.

claimant-statement.description: Written or transcribed statement from the claimant.

witness-statement.description: Written or transcribed statement from a witness.

carrier-letter.description: Letter from the insurance carrier (this or another).

unknown.description: Catch-all for documents that don't fit elsewhere. Triggers human review.
